source: Stick Brand Bible + commercial strategy + website
rules: One sentence per beat. Two sentences max.
Period as drumbeat. Setup:payoff uses period, not comma.
The joke is shared with the golfer, never directed at them.
Every cheeky line lands on a thing we can help with (a CTA, an offering, a 'why it's here').
Never use expertise to make the golfer feel stupid.
Sentence case. Period as default terminator.

headlines.text: Takomo 101T. Forged once, normalised. The grain is the spec.

Vice balls. Tested on TrackMan before they hit the shelf.

Off-rack clubs. The budget option that costs you strokes.
Hope isn't a fitting strategy. But we are.
Range balls. The lie you keep telling yourself.
Off-the-rack shoes? You wouldn't. So why your driver?
You changed your grip. Twice. The slice didn't notice.
Fit first. Buy second. A 30-min session that ends with the right club in your hand.
Everything has to earn its place. Including your next driver.
Better begins here. We measure it.
When your mate says 'I'll fix it myself'. We've all been there. Almost.
Paarl mornings. The fitting studio stays open.
Regrip. Reshaft. Replay. Workshop services that respect the club.
Me: I'll fix my slice this winter. Also me: buys new driver. The fitting helps. Promise.
Stick matches equipment to the player. Never the other way around.
